description_en: Creates a rule action under a specified rule to define how processed topic data is forwarded to other topics on IoT Platform or to other supported Alibaba Cloud services
description_zh: 调用该接口在指定的规则下创建一个规则动作，定义将处理后的Topic数据，转发至物联网平台的其他Topic，或所支持的其他阿里云服务
name: CreateRuleAction

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or</ph></props> ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the rule for which you want to create an action. You can view the rule ID on the Rules Engine > Data Forwarding page <props="china"><ph>of the corresponding instance</ph></props> in the IoT Platform console, or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69486.html to obtain the rule ID from the response
parameters.help_zh: 要为其创建动作的规则ID。可在物联网平台控制台<props="china"><ph>对应实例下</ph></props>，规则引擎>云产品流转页查看规则ID，或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69486.html从返回结果中查看
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the rule action. Valid values:

REPUBLISH: forwards the processed topic data to another IoT Platform topic.
AMQP: data forwarding to an AMQP consumer group.
<props="china">- DATAHUB: forwards the processed topic data to Alibaba Cloud DataHub for data stream processing.</props>
<props="china">- ONS: forwards the processed topic data to ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ for message distribution.</props>
MNS: sends the processed topic data to Alibaba Cloud Message Service for message transmission.
FC: sends the processed topic data to Alibaba Cloud Function Compute for event computing.
OTS: sends the processed topic data to Alibaba Cloud Tablestore for NoSQL data storage.

Rules whose data format is binary (the DataType parameter of the rule is BINARY) do not support forwarding data to OTS (Tablestore)
parameters.help_zh:
规则动作类型，取值：

REPUBLISH：将根据规则处理后的Topic数据转发至另一个物联网平台 Topic。
AMQP：数据流转到AMQP消费组。
<props="china">- DATAHUB：将根据规则处理后的Topic数据转发至阿里云DataHub，进行流式数据处理。</props>
<props="china">- ONS：将根据规则处理后的Topic数据转发至阿里云消息队列RocketMQ，进行消息分发。</props>
MNS：将根据规则处理后的Topic数据发送至阿里云消息服务中，进行消息传输。
FC：将根据规则处理后的Topic数据发送至阿里云函数计算服务，进行事件计算。
OTS：将根据规则处理后的Topic数据发送至阿里云表格存储（Tablestore），进行NoSQL数据存储。

数据格式为二进制的规则（即规则的DataType参数是BINARY）不支持转发数据至OTS（表格存储）
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The configurations of the rule action. The value is a JSON string. The content varies based on the rule action type. For specific requirements and examples, see the supplementary description of request parameters below
parameters.help_zh: 该规则动作的配置信息，传入格式为JSON String。不同规则动作类型所需内容不同，具体要求和示例见下文请求参数补充说明
parameters.name: configuration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the rule action forwards error operation data, which is data that fails to be forwarded to other cloud services and also fails after retries. Valid values:

true: The rule action forwards error operation data.
false: The rule action does not forward error operation data. Instead, it performs normal forwarding.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
该规则动作是否为转发错误操作数据的转发动作，即转发流转到其他云产品失败且重试失败的数据。 可选值：

true：该规则动作转发错误操作数据。
false：该规则动作不转发错误操作数据，而是正常转发操作。

默认值为false
parameters.name: error_action_flag

ActionId.description_en:
The rule action ID generated by the rules engine for the rule action if the call succeeds. This ID serves as the identifier of the rule action.

Keep this information secure. You may need to provide the rule action ID when you call operations related to rule actions

请妥善保管该信息。在调用与规则动作相关的接口时，您可能需要提供对应的规则动作ID
